label: Actual CONCRETE_6 root determinations are pure, from De ente's other cause (inference)
rule: For an actual root: esse equals essence from the other-cause step and the esse-cause bridge; it is first among the simply prior; so it is not composite, has no distinct esse and nothing distinct is prior to it, and the open bridge gives pure determinations
meaning: Sibling of ROOT-PURITY-FROM-NO-LIMITATION (dcea77db) in which the #1629 step 457698e4 (another actual cause of being, mode unspecified) replaces the q.3 a.4 causal dichotomy be639b3f and the no-efficient-self-cause premise 61bd42e5, whose prose reads the cause as efficient. Every other input is unchanged. The step is used only to give each actual root esse equal to essence; no efficient cause is used or concluded.
